disposition_reason: Table 2 prints lead and cadmium means by season and year, seasonal ranges and overall means (mg/kg) for commercial wheat flour bought in Khuzestan province from 2016 to 2018.

study.design: Market survey with health risk assessment
study.origin: not stated (commercial flour brands; Khuzestan is described as a wheat-producing region)
study.market: randomly purchased from the market, Khuzestan province, Iran
study.method: Oven drying at 100 C, HNO3/HClO4 microwave digestion (EPA 3050B), GFAAS (Varian 240FS)
study.qa: SRM rice flour IRMM 804; recoveries Pb 89%, Cd 101%; RSD below 5%; triplicate replicates and reagent blanks

unresolved: Sample size and brand count conflict: abstract says 300 samples of five brands; methods say 335 samples of four brands; Table 2 seasonal n sums to 335.
Summer 2018 lead mean 0.50 mg/kg likely a misprint of 0.050.
Winter lead range printed 0.06-160; summer range minimum 0.06 sits above two of its year means.
Lead exceedance printed as 11% (n = 5) of 111 summer samples; 5/111 is 4.5%.
Several SDs exceed their means by far (for example spring Cd 2016 0.011 +/- 0.064; overall Pb 0.0633 +/- 0.35); printed as is.
Average-row 'Range' cells (Pb 0.052-0.075, Cd 0.013-0.018) are ranges of the year means, not sample ranges; not recorded as findings.
Detection limits were estimated but not printed.
